about: outdoor_plants' truth mappings for claims about its state (kernel/speech.py truth(); VERIFY_HARDENING 13.1-13.3, 13.6; WP-D outdoor_plants). Words from house_sim/data/vocab/outdoor_plants.json and the living words of core.json (needs_water, dry_soil, pests, overgrown; wilted, clogged and overflowing are the kernel's truth.json: see the handoff's requests for the fields this domain's records hold). Conditions read the thing's own record, hidden fields included. A plant's record says whether it has an issue through the fields of plants.plant_status and its leaf counts; the last row of a list (a plant's or a lawn's field that never holds) makes a sound thing false, not unknown, wherever its own field is absent or null. needs_water, overwatered, dry_soil: the status plant_status derives from the root-zone water against the species' band. dead_leaves, yellowing: the leaf counts. disease: leaf spots or the diseased flag. root_bound, frost_damage, sunscald, leggy, bolting: the plant's own flags and its symptoms. leaning: over 15 degrees. weeds: a bed's weeds, cracks in paving, a lawn's weed patches. thin_patches: a lawn's bare patches or a thin one. mole_hills, grubs, mushrooms: the hidden issues of a lawn (the kinds helpers.lawn lays). overgrown: a lawn whose mean height is over 90 mm, a hedge over 2 m. icy: ice over 0.1 of a surface. snow_covered: more than 1 cm. blown_over: blown away or lying on its side. acts: fertilize, rake, mow, prune are said of this domain's verbs when the lexicon has them; water is the kernel's.
